name: Indian Sign Language
source: SignBridge ISL starter lexicon (handshape-location-movement reference mapping)
note: Experimental ISL animations generated from handshape-location-movement descriptions. NO entry has been reviewed by a qualified ISL interpreter, so none is marked verified. To mark an entry reviewed set review_status='interpreter_reviewed' and fill reviewed_by and reviewed_at; an entry without that evidence is always treated as experimental. Words outside this lexicon are never animated.

entries.label: Hello
entries.description: Open right hand at shoulder height, palm forward, wave gently twice with a smile.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Good morning
entries.description: Flat right hand at the chin moves forward and slightly up, with a smile.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Good afternoon
entries.description: Flat right hand at the chin moves outward to the right, with a smile.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Good evening
entries.description: Flat right hand at the chin moves downward, with a calm smile.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Good night
entries.description: Flat right hand at the chin moves down twice, with the head tipped slightly forward.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Thank you
entries.description: Fingertips of the flat right hand touch the chin and move forward toward the listener, with a smile.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Please
entries.description: Flat right palm circles on the chest, with a polite smile.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Sorry
entries.description: Fist circles on the chest with a regretful expression and a slight forward head tilt.
entries.source: SignBridge experimental ISL mapping (handshape-location-movement description; NOT interpreter-reviewed)

entries.label: Welcome

entries.label: Goodbye

entries.label: Nice to meet you
